verdict.rationale: Datadog is core-built around unified metrics/logs/traces with APM, Log Management, and tracing docs, plus community confirmation that correlation via tagging across APM, metrics, and logs is a key differentiator (datadog-comm-3, datadog-comm-6). Some community pushback exists on correlation quality relative to niche competitors (datadog-comm-5), but this is a comparative gripe, not evidence the capability fails outright, so it counts against quality rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of cross-pillar pivoting UX, and more detail on trace-to-log-to-metric linking mechanics beyond marketing docs.
